note: Rejudged against RFC 7950 Sections 8.1 and 8.3.3, the checklist gap annotation, and the current end-of-operation producers. validateStagedTree invokes the supplied pre-commit validation; sectionErrors invokes ValidateCustomSections on the active tree. ValidateCustomSections checks registered original-tree validators, listed sections' type and custom validators, mandatory nodes and whole-tree references through referenceFailures. The changed sectionErrors renders typed refusal details but adds no general when, unique or choice-exclusivity enforcement. walkTree and requireMandatoryChildren validate values, cardinality and mandatory choice presence; requireMandatoryInPresentCases checks every present case but does not reject two cases. CaseInEffect suppresses defaults when multiple cases hold data rather than rejecting that data. ze-iface-conf still declares ethernet unique mac/address and mac/match constraints. The existing gap annotation remains accurate: the final running/startup contents do not receive all Section 8.1 constraint checks. This row has no tagged tests; this is missing behavior, not a claim that the entire YANG constraint model is implemented. Source review only; no tests executed by this reviewer.
